# The team behind   Rasayel

We are a crew of passionate, diverse and hardworking dreamers. We think from first principles and don't shy away from hard work - if it needs to get done, we get it done. We've created an environment where everyone can share their ideas, be heard, and learn from each other.

We're out there to make our dreams come true - one brush stroke, one line of code, one article, one conversation at a time!

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/FixX4U8HY9e4TPfSRUcNK7EHLNY.svg)

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/RmksEimlCDhw5ysSUkvtau0IQ.svg)

##### An experienced team

Our team has acquired domain knowledge and expertise in from top companies around the globe.

##### Backed by world-class investors

Being backed by world class investors give us the means to pursue of mission with access to the best talents and advisors.

##### +5 years in the making

We have been working hard for over 5 years and are optimising for long-term impact.

## Meet our team

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/IyvbOmAOCNnCN076vO0p8XMVY.jpg?width=819&height=819)

Tarek Khalil

CEO & Co-founder

Tarek previously worked as product engineer at Intercom. Prior to that, he travelled to live and work in numerous places around the world.
He's now living in a small fishing town in rural south Ireland, and enjoys the nature around.He climbs hills whenever he can, and enjoys the rare, but lovely Irish sunny days.

🇮🇪 Ireland

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/jezo2o4o7nrYRLWhxtsyJLyHs.jpg?width=800&height=800)

Mohamed Elbadwihi

COO & Co-founder

Mohamed has a background in digital enterprise strategy and software engineering. When he's not staring at his computer screen, he can be found staring at the night sky somewhere in Alberta, Canada, where he moved a year ago. He enjoys reading, and writing about the things he reads.

🇨🇦 Canada

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Y3HO9IH7nPhgr1lQUXE3ZVoQcFg.jpg?width=460&height=456)

Customer Success & Support

🇵🇹 Portugal

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/PhGVGxyMFWW2qgBCbbyTt036NtE.jpg?width=280&height=280)

Product & Design

Antoine has 8+ years experience researching and designing products from start to finish. He worked at CitizenLab, Remi, CentralApp and is certified from Cambridge University. He is a new dad and loves playing tennis multiple times a week.

🇧🇪 Belgium

Engineering

Growth & Operations

Brian is a growth & operations expert bringing over 10 years of experience in SaaS growth & operations. As a co-founder of several companies & a Techstars alum, he helped launch Wayflyer, which became a unicorn in 2022. Currently, Brian supports founders in growth & operational projects. Off-duty, he enjoys surfing & hiking.

🇮🇪 Ireland

Engineering

Sales

Product Marketing

Product Marketing
